item.text: The request uses the common invariant convention \(q^2=-0.5\), but EXCLURAD’s input field is \(Q^2\equiv -q^2>0\). I’m correcting the input value to \(Q^2=+0.5\ \mathrm{GeV}^2\), then checking accessibility and table coverage before generation.

The corrected point passes all physical checks available to the server. Generation completed with one residual warning: the lookup table file is not present in this working directory, so the server could not scan and independently verify its \((W,Q^2)\) grid coverage.
